text:
`python3 -m unittest` now passes all 16 tests. I didn't touch the tests. These are the fixes in `catalog/`:

- **`books.py`**: `parse_book` now converts the year to an `int`.
- **`members.py`**: `MAX_BORROWED` is now 5, as the comment and tests say.
- **`search.py`**: it imported `normalize` from a module that doesn't exist, so it now imports from `catalog.text`.
- **`fees.py`**: the fee was `days_late + DAILY_FEE`, and it is now `days_late * DAILY_FEE`.
- **`inventory.py`**: `recent(n)` returned `n + 1` events because of an off-by-one in the slice. It now returns exactly `n`, and `recent(0)` returns an empty list.
- **`factory.py`**: `sample_books()` was missing the third title, so I added `Emma` by Austen (1815, 1 copy). The tests only check the title, so the author, year and copies are my guess.

The run showed 15 tests at first because `tests/test_search.py` couldn't be imported. Once `search.py` was fixed, its tests were counted too.
